culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. Visit Greenland: ask before photographing people and accept a no. Don't photograph children without a parent's consent. Watch hunting and flensing respectfully. Keep away from working sled dogs, follow your guide, stay on paths in settlements, and take your shoes off when invited into a home.

laws.rule: Every visitor to the Northeast Greenland National Park needs prior Government of Greenland permission: a National Park permit for land visits under 24 hours, and an expedition permit as well for longer stays or travel in the park's waters. Apply at least 12 weeks ahead.
In the National Park, do not disturb wildlife, leave waste or collect cultural remains.
